name: proxy
description: Administer the hosted Proxy Smart deployment from the conversation. Bundles the smart-app-onboarding and smart-launch-debugging skills + the Proxy Smart MCP server at api.proxy-smart.com, whose tools are generated from the admin API: register and configure SMART apps, manage scopes and scope sets, healthcare users and practitioner roles, FHIR servers, identity providers, and Keycloak Organizations.

interface.displayName: Proxy Smart — SMART on FHIR administration
interface.shortDescription: Administer the hosted Proxy Smart deployment from the conversation.
interface.longDescription: Proxy Smart sits between SMART apps and FHIR servers and handles OAuth 2.0 and SMART App Launch 2.2.0. This plugin connects an assistant to the hosted deployment's admin API over MCP, so registering an app, choosing its scopes and launch type, wiring FHIR server access and Keycloak Organizations, and working out why a launch or token failed all happen in the conversation instead of the console.
